decisions.decision: Leading whitespace disqualifies a marker line; trailing whitespace, including \r, is ignored.
Sort by created_at; ties keep the tracker's listing order; a missing created_at sorts after every timestamped comment.
The region runs from the first open marker line to the first close marker line after it; later markers are ordinary text and are preserved.
Lines inside a fenced code block (``` or ~~~) are never marker lines.
decisions.note: This changes the literal matching rule in the pinned prose. The measured run already ignored the fenced example.

decisions.decision:
Text outside the region is kept byte for byte, CRLF included; the region is always written marker_open
body
marker_close. A  before 
 is trailing whitespace of its line, so on a marker line it is rewritten with the region.
Marker lines stay whole lines: the region runs from the start of the open marker line to the end of the close marker line and is written marker_open\nbody\nmarker_close.
